draft_to_experimental: positive and counterexample routing evidence present
recognition, application, and counterexample behavior cases present
experimental_to_active: same RED cases pass after the change
local or CI execution evidence is attached
active_to_stable: behavior evidence remains green across releases
context cost and maintenance burden remain acceptable
replacement and deprecation risks are reviewed
deprecated: replacement skill or ordinary workflow is named
new routing no longer selects the deprecated skill

review_triggers: three repeated contract-valid routing misses with verified context
a behavior regression on an existing case
a new adjacent skill creates scope overlap
the routing reference or selected-skill context no longer fits its supported budget
a deterministic grader produces a demonstrated false positive or false negative
a user correction reveals a reusable missing safeguard
the skill has not been reviewed for two feature releases
